main_body: A green hedge/bush strip about 36x14 px: a lighter green upper band (rows 1-5) over a darker green lower mass (rows 6-12) with a dark base line at rows 13-14.
top_band: Light mid-green foliage band, rows ~1-5, with speckled highlights. It is the same leafy material as the face and only a tonal shift, with no front-edge line or distinct step.
evidence: In a middle column the foliage goes light green (rows 1-5), then medium-dark green (rows 6-12), then a dark base (rows 13-14). The lighter upper part is a gradient of the same foliage rather than a horizontal surface seen from above. There is no front-edge highlight and no overhang shadow, and nothing is inset. It reads as a flat hedge front with a lighter hat, so it fails the 3/4 contract. For organic hedges this is borderline, but strictness applies.

style.evidence: The hedge has about 4 green steps with scattered light and dark pixel clumps, and a dark green base and edge, so the outline is a material tone rather than black. The reference stall and well have more steps, per-material highlights, and distinct structure with more colours per tile. The candidate is a simple, mostly uniform bush slab with sparse texture dots, which is thinner than the references, so it fails.
